calendar.field.title: Title
settings.themeHint: Select a modern FullCalendar stock theme (Breezy, Monarch, Forma, Pulse, Classic), design system (Shadcn, MUI), or heritage palette, plus accent swatch and light/dark mode.
settings.generalHint: Configure the primary local language, optional Arabic/Hijri secondary calendar display, timezone, and daily operating hours.
settings.defaultLocaleHint: Language for month names, weekdays, and toolbar buttons.
settings.secondaryCalendarLanguageHint: Choose whether Hijri dates appear in local language, Arabic script, or hidden.
settings.directionHint: Grid column order (LTR or RTL for Arabic).
settings.timezoneHint: IANA timezone identifier (e.g., UTC or America/New_York).
settings.defaultViewHint: Initial view displayed when opening the calendar.
settings.firstDayHint: Starting weekday column in Month and Week views.
settings.weekCalcHint: Standard used when computing week numbers.
settings.startHourHint: Earliest visible time slot in Week/Day TimeGrid (HH:MM:SS).
settings.endHourHint: Latest visible time slot in Week/Day TimeGrid (HH:MM:SS).
settings.feedTitleHint: Calendar title exported in /api/calendar/feed.ics for Google/Apple/Outlook subscriptions.
settings.sourcesHint: Connects Strapi Collection Types (such as Events or Bookings) so their records are automatically plotted on the unified calendar. Each mapping defines which fields represent the item title, start/end dates, and optional recurrence rules.
settings.noSources: No collection types are mapped yet. Use the form below to plot Events, Bookings, or Articles on the calendar.
settings.badge.title: Title
settings.collectionTypeHint: Select which Strapi Collection Type provides the dated entries.
settings.sourceLabelHint: Human-readable label shown on calendar filter chips.
settings.sourceColorHint: Hex color accent applied to calendar chips for this source.
settings.field.title: Title Field
settings.field.titleHint: Attribute displayed as the calendar event title.
settings.field.startDateHint: Date or DateTime field used to place the entry on the grid.
settings.field.endDateHint: Optional end Date/DateTime attribute for multi-hour or multi-day spans.
settings.field.rruleHint: Optional RFC 5545 RRULE field for repeating schedules.
settings.secondaryCalendarsHint: Display optional secondary dates (such as Hijri Umm al-Qura) alongside Gregorian dates in day cells. Supports local language or Arabic script and moon-sighting day offsets (-2 to +2 days).
settings.calendarPresetHint: Unicode CLDR calendar identifier used by Intl.DateTimeFormat.
settings.calendarIdHint: Unique slug key for this calendar overlay.
settings.calendarLabelHint: Badge label displayed in calendar headers and tooltips.
settings.calendarScriptHint: Locale used to render month names and numerals.
settings.overrideFieldHint: Optional entry field that overrides calculated dates.
settings.error: Could not save or reset settings.

settings.eventsDefaultCapacityHint: Default seat capacity for newly created RSVP events.
settings.eventsMaxGuestsHint: Maximum seats a single RSVP submission may reserve.
settings.eventsWaitlistHint: Automatically promotes waitlisted attendees in FIFO order when a confirmed attendee cancels.
settings.eventsSendEmailsHint: Dispatches confirmation and waitlist promotion emails via the Strapi Email plugin.
